evidence_scope: A. annua nitric-oxide rescue under cadmium stress, trichomes, and artemisinin

title: The Antiviral and Antimalarial Prodrug Artemisinin from the Artemisia Species: A Review.
evidence_scope: artemisinin chemistry, extraction, antimalarial mechanism, and translational review context

title: Chemical composition and toxicity of Moroccan mentha spicata and Artemisia absinthium essential oils against Pthorimaea operculella, the potato moth.
evidence_scope: Moroccan A. absinthium oil composition and stage-specific potato-moth toxicity

title: Antimicrobial sesquiterpene lactones from Artemisia sieberi.
evidence_scope: A. sieberi structure-confirmed sesquiterpene-lactone isolation and antimicrobial context
decision_rationale: Primary isolation study expands STL chemical space; antimicrobial endpoints are not antiparasitic assays and do not establish constituent safety.

title: Artemisinin: an endoperoxidic antimalarial from Artemisia annua L.
evidence_scope: historical artemisinin chemistry and antimalarial review context

title: Indian Santonin: Extracted from the Indian Species of Artemisia Maritima.
evidence_scope: historical A. maritima santonin attribution and vermifuge context
decision_rationale: Historical indexed record with PMC archival access; retained for provenance of santonin use, not for a modern dose, efficacy magnitude, or safety claim.

evidence_scope: comparative East Asian Artemisia essential-oil chemistry and reported biological activities

title: Intraspecific variation in genome size in Artemisia argyi determined using flow cytometry and a genome survey.
evidence_scope: A. argyi accession-level genome-size variation and genome-survey context

evidence_scope: A. annua leaf/root cold-adaptation and de-adaptation transcriptome/metabolite dynamics

title: Comparative and phylogenetic analysis of the complete chloroplast genomes of 10 Artemisia selengensis resources based on high-throughput sequencing.
evidence_scope: A. selengensis resource-level plastome comparison and phylogeny

title: Physiology and transcriptome analysis of Artemisia argyi adaptation and accumulation to soil cadmium.
evidence_scope: A. argyi cadmium stress physiology and terpenoid-related transcriptome response

title: The karyotype, genome survey, and assembly of Mud artemisia (Artemisia selengensis).
evidence_scope: A. selengensis karyotype, genome-size, and preliminary assembly context

evidence_scope: A. sphaerocephala drought and rewatering physiology plus full-length transcriptome

title: Chloroplast genome sequences of Artemisia maritima and Artemisia absinthium: Comparative analyses, mutational hotspots in genus Artemisia and phylogeny in family Asteraceae.
evidence_scope: A. maritima and A. absinthium plastome comparison and wormwood accession sampling

title: Highly oxygenated guaianolides from Artemisia dubia.
evidence_scope: A. dubia highly oxygenated guaianolide isolation

evidence_scope: A. leucophylla eudesmane-type sesquiterpenoid isolation

evidence_scope: A. heptapotamica monomeric/dimeric STL isolation and NF-kB assay

evidence_scope: A. myriantha dimeric guaiane-type sesquiterpenoid isolation
decision_rationale: Primary structure-confirmed isolation expands dimeric STL space; docking/SPR and hepatoma activity are not validated parasite-target evidence.

evidence_scope: A. ordosica mixed C10/C15 heterodimer and sesquiterpenoid isolation
decision_rationale: Primary structure analysis expands mixed terpene architecture; hepatoma activity is not antiparasitic evidence.

title: Artemyriantholides A-K, guaiane-type sesquiterpenoid dimers from Artemisia myriantha var. pleiocephala and their antihepatoma activity.
evidence_scope: A. myriantha var. pleiocephala dimeric STL isolation and computational/SPR target hypothesis

evidence_scope: A. annua HPTLC analytical validation for artemisinin and artemisinic acid

evidence_scope: Hydroalcoholic A. annua artemisinin analytical validation and laboratory transfer

decision_rationale: Primary perturbation study supports a trichome-regulatory edge; it does not establish conserved function or antiparasitic benefit.

title: Marked enhancement in the artemisinin content and biomass productivity in Artemisia annua L. shoots co-cultivated with Piriformospora indica.
evidence_scope: A. annua shoot co-culture with Piriformospora indica and artemisinin production
decision_rationale: Primary plant--microbe production study supports a symbiotic context; it does not establish native field ecology or parasite efficacy.

title: [Analysis of spatial distribution of artemisinin in Artemisia annua in China].
evidence_scope: province-level spatial autocorrelation and climate correlates of A. annua artemisinin
decision_rationale: Observational spatial study supports geography and climate as sampling covariates; region-level association does not establish causality or pathway conservation.

title: Simple and rapid micro-scale quantification of artemisinin in living Artemisia annua L. by improved gas chromatography with electron-capture detection.
evidence_scope: living-leaf and flower microscale artemisinin quality control
decision_rationale: Primary analytical validation supports low-input tissue monitoring; detection does not establish pathway direction or efficacy.

title: A combination of ultrasonic-assisted extraction with RRLC-QQQ method for the determination of artemisinin in the Chinese herb Artemisia annua L.
evidence_scope: ultrasound-assisted extraction and RRLC-triple-quadrupole MS validation
decision_rationale: Primary analytical validation supports sensitive lot-specific measurement; analytical recovery is not bioavailability or parasite efficacy.

title: In vitro assessment of cytotoxic, genotoxic and mutagenic effects of antimalarial drugs artemisinin and artemether in human lymphocytes.
evidence_scope: artemisinin and artemether genotoxicity in cultured human lymphocytes
decision_rationale: Primary human-cell study supports an in-vitro genotoxicity boundary; it does not define clinical risk or whole-plant safety.

title: Simple field assays to check quality of current artemisinin-based antimalarial combination formulations.
evidence_scope: field TLC quality checks for defined artemisinin-based combination formulations
decision_rationale: Primary drug-quality study supports malaria stewardship and counterfeit detection; it does not establish crude Artemisia equivalence.

title: Determination of artemisinin and its analogs in Artemisia annua extracts by capillary electrophoresis - Mass spectrometry.
evidence_scope: capillary electrophoresis--MS separation of artemisinin and related analogs in A. annua extracts
decision_rationale: Primary analytical study supports analog- and diastereomer-aware measurement; detection does not establish native flux or parasite mechanism.

title: Antimalarial and anticancer properties of artesunate and other artemisinins: current development.
evidence_scope: artemisinin and artesunate antimalarial development, endoperoxide mechanism, and resistance context
decision_rationale: Review provides malaria framing and derivative context; it is not a primary plant-chemistry, parasite-target, or crude-Artemisia efficacy study.

title: Nutrient deficiency in the production of artemisinin, dihydroartemisinic acid, and artemisinic acid in Artemisia annua L.
evidence_scope: potassium and macronutrient effects on artemisinin concentration and yield
decision_rationale: Controlled nutrient experiment informs environment-production tradeoffs; it does not establish parasite efficacy or a universal agronomic optimum.

title: Selection of safe artemisinin derivatives using a machine learning-based cardiotoxicity platform and in vitro and in vivo validation.
evidence_scope: artemisinin-derivative cardiotoxicity prediction with cell and zebrafish validation
decision_rationale: Primary safety-method study is relevant to derivative translation; computational filtering and limited validation do not establish clinical safety or plant-preparation safety.

title: Use of Model-Based Nutrient Feeding for Improved Production of Artemisinin by Hairy Roots of Artemisia Annua in a Modified Stirred Tank Bioreactor.
evidence_scope: fed-batch hairy-root modeling and bioreactor artemisinin production
decision_rationale: Primary process study supports engineered production and nutrient-control design; hairy-root yield is not native field flux or antiparasitic efficacy.

title: Optimization of artemisinin extraction from Artemisia annua L. with supercritical carbon dioxide + ethanol using response surface methodology.
evidence_scope: supercritical carbon dioxide extraction parameters, yield, and comparison with Soxhlet extraction
decision_rationale: Primary extraction study supports process-aware measurement; extract yield and purity do not establish clinical suitability or parasite activity.

title: Arbuscular Mycorrhizal Fungus Rhizophagus irregularis Influences Artemisia annua Plant Parameters and Artemisinin Content under Different Soil Types and Cultivation Methods.
evidence_scope: soil-, cultivation-, and AMF-dependent effects on biomass, glandular trichomes, essential oil, and artemisinin
decision_rationale: Primary plant--microbe study supports context-dependent chemotype modulation; open-field and semi-open results diverge and no parasite endpoint was tested.

title: Impact of Phosphatic Nutrition on Growth Parameters and Artemisinin Production in Artemisia annua Plants Inoculated or Not with Funneliformis mosseae.
evidence_scope: phosphate gradient and AMF effects on A. annua growth and artemisinin
decision_rationale: Controlled nutrition study supports soil-by-symbiont interaction; the reported concentration response is not a universal production or efficacy rule.

title: Dimeric guaianolides from Artemisia absinthium.
evidence_scope: structure-confirmed absinthins A-E and known dimeric guaianolides from A. absinthium
decision_rationale: Primary isolation study expands authenticated wormwood STL space; BV-2 nitric-oxide inhibition is not an anthelmintic or parasite-protein result.

title: Analysis of the major chiral compounds of Artemisia herba-alba essential oils (EOs) using reconstructed vibrational circular dichroism (VCD) spectra: En route to a VCD chiral signature of EOs.
evidence_scope: chiral composition and absolute configuration of thujones and camphor in four A. herba-alba oils
decision_rationale: Primary analytical study supports stereochemistry-aware oil authentication; A. herba-alba composition cannot be transferred to A. absinthium or vermifuge efficacy.

title: Exploring the Effects of Artemisia absinthium L. Essential Oil on Pseudopregnancy Model in Rats.
evidence_scope: A. absinthium oil composition and oral reproductive-endocrine pharmacology in pseudopregnant rats
decision_rationale: Primary animal study supports reproductive exposure caution and lot-specific chemistry; it is not an anthelmintic efficacy or human safety study.

title: Acaricidal activity of Artemisia herba-alba and Melia azedarach oil nanoemulsion against Hyalomma dromedarii and their toxicity on Swiss albino mice.
evidence_scope: A. herba-alba oil nanoemulsion against multiple tick stages with mouse toxicity endpoints
decision_rationale: Primary tick-stage and host-toxicity study strengthens the preparation/formulation boundary; nanoemulsion and mixed-oil chemistry do not establish a native terpene mechanism or human safety.

title: Chemical Diversity and Anti-Insect Activity Evaluation of Essential Oils Extracted from Five Artemisia Species.
evidence_scope: five-species essential-oil chemotype comparison with contact-toxicity and repellency assays
decision_rationale: Primary cross-species study links volatile chemical diversity to insect phenotypes; it remains mixture-level and insect-specific.

title: Two novel sesquiterpenes and one new monoterpene from the aerial part of Artemisia tournefortiana.
evidence_scope: structure-confirmed isolation of two sesquiterpenes and one monoterpene from A. tournefortiana
decision_rationale: Primary NMR/HRESIMS/ECD isolation study expands authenticated terpene space; reported antibacterial activity is not antiparasitic evidence.

title: Chemical Composition of Essential Oils from Natural Populations of Artemisia scoparia Collected at Different Altitudes: Antibacterial, Mosquito Repellent, and Larvicidal Effects.
evidence_scope: altitude-associated A. scoparia oil composition, mosquito repellency, and larvicidal activity
decision_rationale: Primary population comparison supports environment-by-chemotype effects; oil activity is mixture-level and vector-specific.

title: Evaluation of Chemical Composition, Acaricidal, and Repellent Activities of Artemisia vulgaris L. (Asteraceae) Essential Oil Against Gall Mite Aceria pongamiae Keifer (Acarina: Eriophyidae).
evidence_scope: A. vulgaris oil composition with time- and concentration-dependent fumigant, contact, and repellent effects against a gall mite
decision_rationale: Primary GC-MS/MS and mite assay supports a preparation-specific acaricide phenotype; reported composition includes non-terpene assignments and does not establish constituent causality.

title: Comprehensive Analysis of Artemisia argyi H. Lév. & Vaniot Essential Oil: Chemical Composition, Antimicrobial Efficacy, Biofilm Disruption, and Insecticidal Potential.
evidence_scope: A. argyi leaf oil composition and Callosobruchus maculatus insecticidal assay
decision_rationale: Primary analytical and insect-control study adds a recent A. argyi chemotype; mortality at high oil concentration is mixture-level and not a helminth or malaria endpoint.

title: Effect of arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) colonization on terpene emission and content of Artemisia annua L.
evidence_scope: AM-fungus and soil-microbe effects on A. annua volatile emission, leaf terpene content, and sesquiterpene accumulation
decision_rationale: Primary leaf-cuvette GC-MS study controls for plant size with phosphorus supplementation; effects are compound-specific and context-dependent, not a parasite result.

title: In-Vitro Assessment of the Acaricidal Properties of Artemisia annua and Zataria multiflora Essential Oils to Control Cattle Ticks.
evidence_scope: A. annua oil dose- and time-dependent activity against engorged Rhipicephalus annulatus ticks and egg-laying failure
decision_rationale: Primary veterinary ectoparasite assay; oil composition and host safety were not resolved, so it does not establish a defined terpene or livestock treatment.

title: Enhanced production of artemisinin by hairy root cultivation of Artemisia annua in a modified stirred tank reactor.
evidence_scope: oxygen, medium optimization, methyl-jasmonate elicitation, and stirred-tank hairy-root artemisinin production
decision_rationale: Primary engineered-production study; bioreactor output is not native field flux, antimalarial exposure, or evidence for cross-species pathway conservation.

title: Development of a Specific Monoclonal Antibody for the Quantification of Artemisinin in Artemisia annua and Rat Serum.
evidence_scope: artemisinin-specific monoclonal immunoassay validated against HPLC and applied to plant extracts and rat serum
decision_rationale: Primary analytical/pharmacokinetic method supports analyte-specific measurement; assay performance does not establish parasite efficacy or clinical safety.

title: Simultaneous Quantification of Five Sesquiterpene Components after Ultrasound Extraction in Artemisia annua L. by an Accurate and Rapid UPLC-PDA Assay.
evidence_scope: validated simultaneous UPLC-PDA measurement of artemisinin, arteannuin B, arteannuin C, dihydroartemisinic acid, and artemisinic acid
decision_rationale: Primary quantitative method strengthens analog-aware artemisinin chemistry; measured concentration is not pathway flux or parasite activity.

title: Phytochemical analysis and geographic assessment of flavonoids, coumarins and sesquiterpenes in Artemisia annua L. based on HPLC-DAD quantification and LC-ESI-QTOF-MS/MS confirmation.
evidence_scope: geographic variation and orthogonal confirmation of artemisinin, arteannuin B, artemisinic acid, and related metabolites across A. annua samples
decision_rationale: Primary regional chemotype study supports geography-aware quality assessment; clinical or parasite effects were not tested.

title: Acaricidal activity against Ixodes ricinus nymphs of essential oils from the Libyan plants Artemisia herba alba, Origanum majorana and Juniperus phoenicea.
evidence_scope: A. herba-alba oil concentration- and time-dependent activity against Ixodes ricinus nymphs
decision_rationale: Primary tick assay adds a vector-borne disease ectoparasite comparator; oil activity remains mixture-level and no human safety or causal constituent was established.

title: Multivariate Analysis of Essential Oil Composition of Artemisia annua L. Collected from Different Locations in Korea.
evidence_scope: 103 A. annua individuals grown under common conditions, GC-MS oil profiles, and six chemotype labels
decision_rationale: Primary common-environment population study separates intraspecific chemical diversity from immediate growth conditions; it does not establish genetic loci or parasite activity.

title: Oxidative stress changes the effectiveness of artemisinin in Plasmodium falciparum.
evidence_scope: malaria parasite-state modulation of artemisinin susceptibility
decision_rationale: Primary matched oxidative-stress susceptibility study strengthens the malaria resistance section; it does not establish plant-chemotype causality or a sole parasite target.

title: Enhanced cell stress response and protein degradation capacity underlie artemisinin resistance in Plasmodium falciparum.
evidence_scope: malaria proteostasis and artemisinin-resistance mechanism
decision_rationale: Primary chemical-genetic study links UPR/proteasome function to DHA survival independently of Kelch13; it does not identify a sole direct drug-binding subunit or a botanical intervention.
